name: an Ordered type orders by key, then id; an absent or null key sorts as the empty key; a dead record is left out
keys compare by bytes: Zz before a0 before a0V before a1
ids on a tied key compare by bytes: - before A before _ before a
drawn leaves out a member inside its delete window
stored keeps a member inside its delete window
a type that is not Ordered orders by id; a dead record is left out
tuple ids order by the UTF-8 bytes of their JCS
a type without life lists only records whose visibleWhen fields hold neither null nor the empty text
a singleton is always visible
children lists the visible laps whose runId names the run, by id
children of another run
children of a run with no laps is empty
top anchors below nothing
bottom anchors below the last stored member, one inside its delete window included
bottom anchors below a stored member that drawn does not hold at all
bottom anchors below the last stored member when none is held
bottom over an empty list anchors below nothing
bottom over only dead members anchors below nothing
bottom on a tied key anchors below the greater id
bottom passes over a member with no key, which sorts first
below a member anchors below it
below a member inside its delete window anchors below it
a move below the member already above it is unchanged
the member above is read in drawn order: a held member between them does not count
a move below itself is unchanged
a move of the first member to the top is unchanged
a move to the top writes one move below nothing
a move below a later member writes one move
a move below a held member that drawn does not show writes one move
a move of a member inside its delete window is gone
a move of an absent record is gone
a removal of a member inside its delete window is unchanged: drawn no longer shows it
a removal of a drawn card is one held delete
a removal of a drawn day puts it absent, held
a null register reads as absent: a card whose title is null decodes at its default
